info.title: Firsta & Talitha Invitation API
info.description: Authoritative local contract. Same-origin cookies; no public admin credentials or visitor IDs accepted from browser.

post.description: Same-origin JSON only. Password verified using scrypt hash. Sets HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie, Secure in production. Rate limited.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Token returned by admin session/login, matching HttpOnly cookie session.

put.summary: Upload/replaces a photo or MP3 music slot
put.description: Raw binary body, no multipart. Photos up to 12 MiB, decoded/re-encoded by Sharp; music MP3 up to 25 MiB with frame validation. Old file removed after committed replacement. The preview slot creates a public 1200×630 JPEG for link thumbnails; other media remains session-protected.

post.description: Validates secret link hash. Origin required. Sets challenge cookie. Does not register a device.

post.summary: Verify Fingerprint event and register up to three visitors
post.description: Server v4 API verifies event age, linked_id challenge, origin, visitor identity and anti-tampering signals. Atomic Postgres transaction deduplicates visitor, rejects fourth, consumes challenge/event and issues HttpOnly guest session.

get.description: Development /preview can read demo content; production always requires active guest session or admin session.
Custom HTTPS origin only after subdomain Active; empty endpoint uses CDN. Region is ap. Contains no secret key.
No authentication required. Only the preview slot is readable here. Replacement changes its ID and revokes the old URL. Supports a single byte Range.

206.description: Partial JPEG for a valid Range header

404.description: Image missing, replaced, deleted, or ID belongs to a private media slot

put.summary: Save attendance and a congratulatory wish
put.description: Replace the current guest response, one per invitation shared across devices. Guest identity comes only from the active cookie session. Same-origin Origin header is mandatory; guests have no CSRF token. Attendance/count remain private to the guest and admin. Guest deletion cascades to their response.

get.description: Only nonempty wishes from active guests. No attendance, count, guest ID, phone or invitation link. Ten per page ordered by latest update then guest ID. Offset pages may shift when wishes change. Production needs guest or admin cookie; development previews can read.

phone.description: Optional phone number. Accepts 08…, 62…, or +country code, spaces, hyphens and parentheses; saved as 8–15 international digits. Empty clears it.
Optional phone number. Accepts 08…, 62…, or +country code, spaces, hyphens and parentheses; saved as 8–15 international digits. Empty clears it.

link.description: Persisted secret invitation URL, visible only to admins. Null for guests created before link storage; existing access remains valid until reissue.

message.description: Trimmed plain text. Empty removes the wish. Visible to other invited guests.

link.description: Secret invitation URL, stored for later copying from the authenticated admin guest list.

mapEmbedUrl.description: Empty or an HTTPS www.google.com/maps/embed URL; other origins rejected.

ceremonyTitle.description: Editable first event name; empty uses Prosesi Pernikahan.

receptionTitle.description: Editable second event name; empty uses Resepsi.

countdownTime.description: Countdown start time on 22 November 2026 in WIB (UTC+07:00). Empty defaults to 00:00.

whatsappTemplate.description: Global WhatsApp message. Supports {nama} and {link}; {link} is required. Admin-only.

linkPreviewTitle.description: Public page and Open Graph title; empty uses Firsta & Talitha — Undangan.

linkPreviewDescription.description: Public description and Open Graph description; empty uses the wedding date and venue.

Media.description: Slot URLs. Preview uses /preview-image/{id}, publicly readable; other slots use authenticated /media/{id}.

settings.description: Public settings only; whatsappTemplate is omitted.
